### Scaling 3D across the company

Rolling out 3D content across an enterprise isn’t just about visuals. It’s about building a system that designers, developers, marketers, and product teams can all live with and build on.

‍

Vectary offers **a professional 3D design studio, DAM and a browser-based 3D viewer** that’s fast, flexible, and built for collaboration. It connects with the tools you already use, scales as your needs grow, and helps teams get all the benefits of working with enterprise-ready 3D assets.

![](https://www.vectary.com/web-assets/media/section.png)

#### Integration

Embed the 3D viewer anywhere (web, docs, presentations). Import CAD and 3D files into one hub for cross-team access. Integration means usable and scalable, not replacing existing tools.

‍

- Synced with database assets via API
- Controlled with SSO user access
- Hosted on dedicated cloud with CDN
- Combined with other collaboration platforms (Miro, Notion, Figma)

![](https://www.vectary.com/web-assets/media/social.png)

#### Collaboration

Traditional 3D tools were built for solo work. Enterprise teams need collaboration for PMs reviewing, marketers embedding, engineers adjusting, often in the same day. Vectary platforms supports teams by allowing:

‍

- Co-editing and project cloning
- Version control
- Automatic sync across shared viewers
- One link sharing of 3D viewers
- In-design 3D comments

![](https://www.vectary.com/web-assets/media/action.png)

#### Security

Protecting 3D files is not just about locking files down, it’s about managing permissions, tracking access, and making sure the platform meets IT standards. Vectary supports enterprise security standards:

‍

- Role-based access
- Complies with SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and CCPA regulations.
- Set up of regular security audits to remain protected and up-to-date.

### Performance

We’ve made performance part of the foundation. Whether it’s a lightweight WebGL experience or a complex scene with multiple components, everything runs directly in the browser with no extra hardware or installs required.

![](https://www.vectary.com/web-assets/media/section.png)

#### Rendering

- Real-time rendering design studio
- Online 3D viewers can handle complex interactions and seamless playback of animations, exploded views, and material variants

![](https://www.vectary.com/web-assets/media/social.png)

#### Optimization

- Polygon reduction
- Decimation
- Texture compression/baking
- High-quality rendering
- GPU memory control

![](https://www.vectary.com/web-assets/media/action.png)

#### Compatibility

- Desktop, phone, tablet (Windows, Android, macOS, iOS)
- All browsers
- WebGL 2.0 and WebGPU compatibility
- Touch option for AR/VR headset

![](https://www.vectary.com/web-assets/media/group-237604-68232730.jpg)

## FAQ - What you can do with Vectary Business Workspaces

If you need additional information about enterprise ready solutions, feel free to contact us directly.

Does Vectary support team collaboration?

Yes. Teams can work on the same 3D projects, clone files, build libraries and share 3D viewers.

Can Vectary fit into my existing workflow?

Yes. Vectary integrates with web tools and productivity platforms fitting into any product development pipeline.

Does the Business plan allow importing CAD files?

Yes. Import STEP, OBJ, and other CAD-compatible formats into the browser for visualization and optimization.

Can I control team member permissions in Vectary?

Yes. Assign roles, view, edit, or admin, to manage project security and access.

Can I use Vectary as a cloud storage tool?

Yes. Organize your workspace into projects that can be stored and accessed from any device.

Can I track changes in my 3D projects?

Yes. Version history stores past edits so you can restore any previous design state instantly.

Is Vectary secure for enterprise use?

Yes. All files are stored in secure cloud servers with controlled team access.

Can I leave comments directly in the design?

Yes. Leave a comment directly in design, attached to the specific part of the model it refers to.
